notes.title: New function update test
notes.notes:
Contents of this update
1. Three islands are added, but the NPC function is not added, which is an empty island
2. Added the professional function of mage and opened the attack function test system for two people
3. Added map of finding necessary items to solve puzzles before going to sea
4. Added the functions of real-time combat and turn based combat by boat at sea, and did not set more test targets
Press the Enter key to launch the shell for attack. Click the mouse to get on the ship
5. Added three kinds of ships for function test
This update can get feedback from all players based on the test. I will continue to revise and add more content
I will continue to add play methods and functions for testing before the full version is released
The images, maps and other contents drawn in this version of the game will be optimized finally
I hope I can finish this work and give you a good experience
